article.title: El-Sayed coverage shows how the media is out of step with the public on Israel
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Abdul El-Sayed's victory over GOP candidate Mike Rogers laid waste to the media narrative that El-Sayed "divided" Democrats over Israel. Yet this obvious Islamophobic bias still dominates coverage of the first Muslim U.S. Senator.
